title: Training Note: Longer Termination Notice and the Early-Termination Charge (Contingency Placement Agreements)
content:
**What is the notice-lead reduction?**
Under the Contingency Placement Agreements, a notice-lead reduction applies to the early-termination charge where the client named a date giving more notice than the tier requires. It is 10 percent where the calendar days from the notice date to the named date are at least one and a half times (1.5 times) the tier's termination notice days, 5 percent where they are at least one and a quarter times (1.25 times) but less than one and a half times that notice period, and nothing otherwise.

**Which dates are compared?**
The notice date is the date the client's termination notice was received; the named date is the effective date the client names in that termination notice. The days between them are the difference in calendar days: the notice date is not counted and the named date is counted.

**Which notice period is the yardstick?**
The termination notice days of the agreement's tier.

**How does the reduction act on the charge?**
It is a share of the early-termination charge after any proration of the fee. It is added together with any other reduction that applies to the same charge into one reduction share, and the charge after proration is reduced once by the share that results; the reductions do not act one after another.

**What if the named date gives no more notice than the tier requires?**
The days from the notice date to the named date are then less than one and a quarter times the notice period, so the reduction is nothing.

## Thresholds worked through (hypothetical tier figures)

| Tier termination notice | 1.25 times | 1.5 times | Named date this many days after the notice date | Reduction |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 60 days | 75 days | 90 days | 90 or more | 10 percent |
| 60 days | 75 days | 90 days | 75 to 89 | 5 percent |
| 60 days | 75 days | 90 days | 74 or fewer | nothing |
| 45 days | 56.25 days | 67.5 days | 68 or more | 10 percent |
| 45 days | 56.25 days | 67.5 days | 57 to 67 | 5 percent |
| 45 days | 56.25 days | 67.5 days | 56 or fewer | nothing |

*Example.* A notice received on 2026-02-01 that names 2026-05-02 gives 90 days; against a 60-day tier notice that is one and a half times, and the reduction is 10 percent. Naming 2026-05-01 gives 89 days, and the reduction is 5 percent.
